items.question: In the first remote litigation hearings the Abu Dhabi Judicial Department announced at the start of COVID-19, how many urgent commercial cases did the Commercial Summary Matters Court examine?
items.gold: 4 urgent commercial cases, heard with all parties present.
items.fact: Abu Dhabi Commercial Summary Matters Court examined 4 urgent cases remotely

items.question: Under the Federal Decree by Law No. 20 of 2022 Regulating the Notary Profession in the UAE, can notaries conduct transactions without the physical presence of the parties?
items.gold: Yes, notaries can conduct all their transactions electronically without physical presence of the parties.
items.fact: UAE notaries may transact electronically without parties' physical presence
